title: The Lighter Brief
overview: This edition mixes some practical money news with a bit of fun. Duke Energy bills in North Carolina are going up in January, and Jamaica's central bank raised rates again to fight inflation. On the lighter side, Rihanna's baby daughter landed a Dior campaign, Eminem's alter ego went after his own awards, and the Harry Potter soundtrack helped scientists study the brain.

stories.headline: Diesel spill reaches Little Sugar Creek near Uptown Charlotte
stories.summary: A car crash on Wednesday spilled about 80 gallons of diesel, and some of it made its way into Little Sugar Creek near Uptown. Cleanup crews are on it, but officials say petroleum spills take time to fully clean up.
key_facts: About 80 gallons of diesel spilled after a crash on Nov. 18
The crash happened at North McDowell and East 6th streets
Cleanup will continue until compliance standards are met
Residents can report suspected pollution by calling 311
stories.why: If you're near the creek and notice anything odd you can see or smell, a quick 311 call helps the cleanup.
